messages:
Ben Morales: Quick sync — Cloud vendor asking for artifacts for the Helios HW marketplace listing. Need SOC2 attestation, redacted pen-test, supplier questionnaire, NDA, and a partner-only engineer bundle. Who's owning?
Anika Rao: I can grab the SOC2 summary and questionnaire from Vault. Will stage to a secure bucket.
Derek Hall: I'll take pen-test redaction. Rules: strip private IPs, redact exploit PoCs, remove device serials from public bundle. Keep CVE IDs and remediation notes.
Priya Shah: Legal wants a redaction manifest (CSV) with `original,redacted,reason` columns and a single-line telemetry statement: "telemetry schema intact; no telemetry values changed."
OpsBot: Reminder: presigned links to external partners require DLP approval and must be tagged `marketplace-evidence`. Default retention=90 days.
Ben Morales: Proposed flow: 1) Anika stages raw artifacts to s3://marketplace-staging/helios-2151234567/ TTL=48h; 2) Derek produces public + partner bundles + manifest; 3) Priya drafts attestation and approves wording; 4) I coordinate marketplace upload and partner delivery.
Anika Rao: Uploaded raw ZIP and enabled access logging. Posted presigned links to #private-partners. Tags set.
Derek Hall: Starting redaction. Will replace emails with <redacted@company>, mask serials in public bundle, and produce `manifest.csv`. ETA 24h.
Priya Shah: I'll draft the attestation: short line confirming no telemetry mutation and sign-off block for Legal. Send draft here once ready.
OpsBot: Auto-check: tags present, access_logging=true. DLP status= pending for external recipients.
Ben Morales: Action owners: Anika=stage+presigns; Derek=redact+manifest; Priya=attestation; Ben=upload+publish. If QA fails on public bundle, we'll delay announcement and notify Comms.
Derek Hall: Noted — will include checksums for telemetry files to prove integrity.
Anika Rao: Extended presign TTL to 72h while we iterate.
Priya Shah: Draft posted — please review and reply with :thumbsup: if ok.
Ben Morales: Thanks team. Tag any blockers here.
Derek Hall: small PII hit in pen-test PDF — will scrub and reupload.
